nom: florence by mills Feed Your Soul Love U A Latte Coffee Glow Mask

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including some who expected to react badly, generally report no irritation or redness from the mask.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the mask leaves their skin moisturized and soft rather than dried out by the exfoliating grounds.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say the mask cleans out pores well, though one notes her skin gets oily again later in the day, which she says is typical for her with most masks.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, easily reactive skin that normally flares into breakouts reports the mask left her skin soft with zero irritation.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with dry skin, describe the mask as surprisingly hydrating rather than drying despite its exfoliating coffee grounds, leaving skin soft and moisturized rather than tight.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily skin say the mask cleans out pores well, though one notes her skin became noticeably oilier again later in the day, which she says is typical of most masks for her.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with reactive or easily irritated skin, report the mask reduced visible redness and caused no irritation; one reviewer with combination, easily triggered skin was cautious going in but had no reaction.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance may be too strong for scent-sensitive users
Thick, sticky texture that's hard to spread neatly
Coffee grounds give only light exfoliation
Leaves skin soft and glowing right after rinsing
Container can leak without a proper seal

extraits.texte: The formula is very thick and sticky. The smell is decent- not too strong. It is a very gentle exfoliator so I would suggest using it as a fun mask rather than a scrub. Unless you really want a gentle scrub. Overall I liked the smell but everything else was a bit of a let down. I received a free sample of this product as a part of #florencepanel.

I have oily skin and this product did a fairly decent job of cleaning out my pores and leaving my face smooth. Although, it did cause my face to get really oily later on (though, most masks do this to my face, so it was to be expected). If you're looking for a refreshing mask that smells good and helps you feel energized, this is it! I was provided a free sample as part of the #florencepanel by Florence by Mills to try the product and write an honest review.

I was provided a free sample of this product with the #florencepanel to provide an honest review. The Feed Your Soul Love U A Latte Coffee Glow Mask' was a non sticky and good textured mask to apply to my skin. The presentation of the mask was clear with a tint of brown with coffee grounds that don't irritate you. The application of the mask was very simple and quick. I just applied it with my finger onto my face and needed little product to cover my face, the product still has a lot of leftover the sample was (smaller than the size of my palm). Waiting 15 minutes for it to be unapplied, my skin was easy to move around (I ate while having it applied and it wasn't a problem) Removing it was also easy just need more scrubbing with warm water than I expected. When I woke up the next morning, I checked my skin, it was soft, and smooth and moisturised (I have dry skin) This is a wonderful product to help clean out pores.

I received this product as a free sample to write a review, and I must say I like it a lot. I've used it so far as a scrub, and it does a great job at hydrating the skin. I have sensitive skin and did not get a reaction from it. One thing is that the smell can be slightly off putting if you don't enjoy a strong coffee scent. #FLORENCEPANEL

Im always cautious when trying new products on my face. Not only do I have combination skin but it is also super sensitive, like instant flurry of breakouts kinda sensitive (I don't wear makeup anymore because of this). Luckily the skin care products from Florence by Mills that I currently use help my face stay clear and balanced out, so I was willing to give this a go when the opportunity came up to participate on the #florencepanel and receive a free sample in exchange for reviewing the product (I got the better side of that deal imo). Now I know it says its a mask but the instructions also stated it could be used as a scrub. Given my skin's fickle disposition I opted to do the scrub. First off the smell, UH-MAZE, its like they bottled the air from a high end coffee joint (you know the ones with the $45 iced coffees, those). Second the consistency, while it could be a little thicker it seems to spread well and doesn't drip off the face and though the scrubbing grounds look sparse, it is the perfect amount to remove dead skin cells while not being too abrasive. The final test is how well my skin feels after (and not just immediately after). Right after use my skin felt soft and there was zero irritation. I'm part of the #florencepanel. I recived a sample from the company and was asked to write a review. I have very sensitive skin and it didn't burn at all. It has a great formula that produces great results. My skin looked and felt more awake afterwords. It was very hydrating and smelled amazing.
